methods.label: Work from the inside outward
methods.explanation:
Evaluate the innermost denominator first: \(1+1=2\). The denominator of the outer fraction is then
\[
1+\frac12=\frac32.
\]
The reciprocal of this positive number is \(\frac23\), so the full expression equals
\[
1+\frac{1}{3/2}=1+\frac23=\frac53.
\]
Both denominators are nonzero. The answer is \(\boxed{\frac53}\), choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
methods.levelReason: The method requires only the order of operations and elementary fraction arithmetic.
